title: UX User Flow Compiler
description: Validates user flow graphs: every path terminates in a classified terminal, no dead-ends or orphan nodes, decision nodes have typed branches, and all edges reference valid nodes. Produces user-flow-artifact.json consumed by task-flow, state-matrix, and wireframe compilers.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract user-flow-spec.json from feature brief, screen map, and role definitions

pipeline.title: Structure
pipeline.description: Validate nodes, edges, and terminal classifications

pipeline.title: Graph Integrity
pipeline.description: Validate reachability, dead-ends, and path finiteness

pipeline.title: Branches
pipeline.description: Validate decision node structure and branch conditions

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: user-flow-spec.json exists with nodes, edges, terminals, and entryNodes arrays

gates.title: Terminal Nodes Classified
gates.description: Every terminal exists in nodes, has type='terminal', and declares a terminalType

gates.title: Edge References Valid
gates.description: Every edge.from and edge.to references an existing node id

gates.title: No Dead Ends
gates.description: Every non-terminal node has at least one outgoing edge

gates.title: No Orphan Nodes
gates.description: Every node is reachable from at least one entry node

gates.title: Finite Paths
gates.description: Every path from entry nodes reaches a terminal (no infinite cycles without exits)

gates.title: Decision Branches
gates.description: Every decision node has at least 2 outgoing edges

gates.title: Branch Conditions Typed
gates.description: Every edge from a decision node declares a conditionType

gates.title: User Flow Contract
gates.description: Full contract: version, flow id, unique node ids, at least one success terminal

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled user flow graphs

error_codes.UXF001: user-flow-spec.json missing or invalid — nodes, edges, terminals, entryNodes required
error_codes.UXF002: Terminal node unclassified — missing terminalType or type != 'terminal'
error_codes.UXF003: Dead-end node — non-terminal node with no outgoing edges
error_codes.UXF004: Orphan node — node unreachable from all entry nodes
error_codes.UXF005: Decision node has fewer than 2 outgoing edges
error_codes.UXF006: Edge references invalid node id (dangling edge)
error_codes.UXF007: Infinite path — cycle with no terminal exit detected
error_codes.UXF009: User flow contract violation — version, flow id, or success terminal missing
